<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/plugin.php';
$found=false;
foreach (get_plugins() as $path=>$meta) {
  if (strpos($path, 'pressedmail/') === 0) {
    $found=true;
    if (is_plugin_active($path)) throw new Exception('PressedMail must stay inactive on SQLite Playground');
    break;
  }
}
if (!$found) throw new Exception('PressedMail package missing');
global $wpdb;
if (stripos((string)$wpdb->db_server_info(), 'sqlite') === false) throw new Exception('This smoke expects disposable SQLite WordPress Playground');
echo 'QD_WEBMAIL_PACKAGE_PRESENT_SQLITE_NOT_ACTIVATED';
